# Baron Klaus von Bachmann

> **Wissenland baron**. Belligerent boor + accomplished diplomate. **Raze Schertal/Graubach/Florianfeld** villages Reikland-Wissenland border pour annexer territoires. **No backing Emmanuelle** — acts alone profitant rise tensions Empire.

## Identité publique
- **Titre** : **Baron Klaus von Bachmann**, Wissenland noble. Réside **Schloss Bachmann** (canon ch.9 l.176).
- **Apparence canon (ch.9 l.185)** : *« tall, barrel-chested, and red-haired, with a florid complexion »*.
- **Personnalité canon** : *« belligerent boor, who uses brute force as a first resort. On the other hand, he has been taught well in the art of diplomacy and uses this to his advantage. Finds it easy to get people to underestimate him »*. *« Brighter and more observant than his blustering persona might reveal »*.
